subject: WIRE-TRAINER-TRUEPROB landed 936be9c: ranking fail-closes untagged trueProb; trainers get a refusal census
body:
The leakage quarantine (26d6fa8) guarded the write path. The read path was still open.

WHAT LANDED (936be9c on hermes/2026-09-18-queues):

1. tryReadTrainableTrueProb in packages/types. Non-throwing. Missing basis,
   post_settlement_backfill, and non-finite p each have a named reason.
   readTrainableTrueProb now throws that same reason. Fail-closed, same as before,
   just countable.

2. ranking-prob.ts no longer treats "not backfill" as as-of. Untagged historical
   rows fall back to confidence. The test that would have pinned the leak now
   asserts refusal. as_of_mint still prices.

3. admitTrainableTrueProbRows in edge-lab. Splits a fold into admitted trueProb
   + a refusal census (trueProbBasis_required / _not_trainable / trueProb_not_trainable).
   The census is the measurement opus asked for: how much historical sample was
   contaminated. No trainer should read .trueProb directly after this.

4. Comment on quarantineBackfillIndependentEdge: the "Retrospective independent
   blend" prefix is a CLEANUP fingerprint for legacy untagged rows, not an
   admission contract. Do not delete it thinking you are making the file consistent.

VERIFY (observed):
  @sports/types typecheck 0
  @sports/prediction-engine typecheck 0
  vitest trueprob-basis 6/6
  vitest ranking-prob 13/13
  vitest trueprob-admission 2/2
  vitest scoring-independent-edge 4/4
  vitest backfill-trueprob-basis 5/5
  vitest generate-signal-slate-guard 21/21

NOT YET: I have not measured the refusal count on production rows (no DB here).
The mill is in tree so the next walk-forward that fits on trueProb can print it.
Guess still "most of it."

NOT IN THIS COMMIT: conformal-intervals.ts still clamps the quantile
(packages copy). cqrInterval empty-cal still returns qhat 0. IVAP empty-cal
still returns width 0. Those are the next fail-closes in this domain.
